summary: The Ector County Independent School District (Ector County ISD) provides detailed comments on the FCC's Notice of Proposed Rulemaking and Further Notice of Proposed Rulemaking regarding the E-Rate program. The District highlights its own network history, showing how the program has supported its infrastructure growth over the past decade. It argues that the program is ongoing and not complete, as the District's network has grown significantly in capacity and cost. The text discusses the automatic 120-day extension of E-Rate deadlines due to COVID-19, indicating a potential sunset of the program. The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, citing budget cost efficiency and cost savings. The Ector County Independent School District supports maintaining the lowest corresponding price protections for E-Rate funding, emphasizing the importance of affordability and cost-effectiveness in ensuring schools can continue to receive affordable connectivity at the lowest available price.
